name: global-section
title: Shared definitions in a global section
summary: A steps widget whose shared numbers (goal, gap) sit in a global section at the top of the root, with a rem comment, and whose ring progress is computed inside the canvas but wrapped in a global command, so the converter moves it before the root where every component can read it.
prompt: A daily steps widget: a green progress ring with the percentage in the middle, and beside it "Steps today", 7,420 and "2,580 to go" against a 10,000 goal; keep the goal and spacing as shared constants.
teaches: Group document-wide definitions in {"global": {"children": [...]}} at the top of a root array: variables (and rem comments) defined once, read anywhere as @goal, @gap

Hoist a value computed where it is drawn: {"global": {"commands": [...]}} inside a canvas moves those commands before the root, so @progress is computed before any layout and is visible to every component
Use the same token in a modifier and a drawing: @gap pads the row and sizes the spacer box
pitfalls: A global section's children must be definitions (variable, definePattern, referencedOperations, createFloatFunction, …); anything else in it is silently skipped

Do not use a vtype color variable as a paint colour: Java writes its id as a literal ARGB (transparent) and json2rc writes opaque black. Colours for paints and text belong in resources.colors, used as @colors.accent
global moves bytes, it does not copy them: the hoisted commands leave the canvas, so anything they define is computed once for the document, not per paint of that canvas
A fixed 140 dp ring leaves the numbers no room on a narrow host: give the ring canvas a weight and draw it from componentWidth()/componentHeight(), capped at its design size

snippets.note: global section: rem plus the goal and gap tokens
global command in a canvas: progress hoisted before the root
rem: a comment stored in the document

check.describe: A green ring three quarters full with 74% inside; beside it "Steps today", 7,420 and green "2,580 to go". Resized (narrow 240, wide 540) the ring and the numbers share the row by weight: the ring is centred in its half, its radius min(56, min(componentWidth(), componentHeight()) / 2 - 14) shrinks on a small host, and the percentage's text size follows the radius.
